test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word

The project's tight deadline and complex requirements made it a __gruelling__ task for the team.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Challenging**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"gruelling"** means something extremely tiring and demanding, often requiring great effort or endurance. (कठिन और थकाने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** The marathon was a gruelling test of both physical and mental strength.
 
 
 
• **"Challenging"** refers to something that tests one's abilities in a stimulating and demanding way, which aligns well with the meaning of "gruelling." (चुनौतीपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** Solving the complex puzzle was challenging but rewarding.
 
 
 
• Both "gruelling" and "challenging" convey the idea of difficulty and effort, making "challenging" the correct synonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Empowering** (सशक्त बनाने वाला): Refers to giving someone the authority or power to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The workshop was aimed at empowering women with the skills to start their own businesses.
 
 
 
• **Inclusive** (समावेशी): Refers to including all kinds of people and treating them fairly and equally.
 
 
• **Example:** The company prides itself on having an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued.
 
 
 
• **Accessible** (सुलभ): Refers to something that is easy to approach, reach, or use.
 
 
• **Example:** The library is accessible to all members of the community.
